query: with locked as materialized ( select id, name from lists where workspace_id = $1 and id = $3 ) update suppressions s set lifted_at = now() from locked l where s.workspace_id = $1 and s.scope = 'list' and s.email_hmac = $2 and s.lifted_at is null and (s.list_id = l.id or (s.list_id is null and s.list_name = l.name))
